title: Size of an expression
statement: Define the size of an expression recursively: a constant has size equal to the assigned length of its base-$2$ digit list; a variable has size $2$; an operation applied to $a$ and $b$ has size $	ext{size}(a)+	ext{size}(b)+1$; and a load applied to $a$ has size $	ext{size}(a)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: An expression in the language of constants, variables, binary operations, and loads
